de.title: Englisch im Meeting: Meinung, Widerspruch, Zusammenfassung
de.intro: Sechs Wendungen für Meetings: eine Meinung äußern, höflich widersprechen und zusammenfassen.

cards.back: meiner Meinung nach. In my opinion, we should move the launch to May.
wie ich es sehe (leitet die eigene Sicht ein). As I see it, the budget is the main risk.
meines Erachtens, nach meinem Dafürhalten. To my mind, the second offer is better.
bei allem Respekt (höfliche Einleitung vor einem Widerspruch). With all due respect, I don't think that will work.
lassen wir es dabei bewenden, dass wir uns nicht einig sind. We won't settle this today, so let's agree to disagree.
kurz gesagt, zusammengefasst. In a nutshell, we need more time and more people.

en.title: English in Meetings: Opinions, Disagreeing, Summing Up
en.intro: Six phrases for meetings: giving an opinion, disagreeing politely and summing up.

cards.back: according to me. In my opinion, we should move the launch to May.
introduces your own point of view. As I see it, the budget is the main risk.
in my view, as I think. To my mind, the second offer is better.
a polite opening before you disagree. With all due respect, I don't think that will work.
let's accept that we will not reach agreement and stop arguing. We won't settle this today, so let's agree to disagree.
in short, in summary. In a nutshell, we need more time and more people.
